Use case: stylized-concept. NEW KFB historical military ink-monster family. Exactly SIX complete unique cartoon-claymation ink blob monsters in a LANDSCAPE 1536x1024 transparent PNG,3 columns x2rows. Reference1 STYLE ONLY for rounded continuous footless ink body and soft plasticine material; reference2 STYLE ONLY for rich sculpted accessory craft. NOT source identities or repeated grins or red eyeballs. Continuous charcoal-black goo body, subtle deep violet sheen, thick soft rounded asymmetrical splat lobes and a few rounded ink droplets. Huge expressive face directly in blob, short goo hands, upright camera-facing. No human torso, legs, feet, bust crops or humanoid action figures. Fine clay fingerprints and thick handmade fabric, leather, metal. Not generic glossy Pixar people; weird, offbeat and tragically relatable military-bureaucracy satire. WHITE/IVORY sclera, RED iris, BLACK pupil, purple eyelids fully filled. Eyes never hidden by hats or goggles. Exactly two female-read through subtle lids/lashes, no human anatomy. Teeth only INSIDE mouth descending from upper gum, never on outer lower lip; closed mouths toothless. Each1–2dominant accessory anchors, body remains visible. Historical visual inspiration, not exact reenactment. No text/lettering/numbers, flags, political emblems, extremist insignia, eagle badges, skull badges, slogans, propaganda or heroic leader portraits. Plain fictional uniforms. No blood/battle scene. Weapons are simple inert period props held safely beside figure; not firing/aiming toward camera.
Family: US-amerikanischer Trupp. Palette and costume: US Army / Army Air Forces inspired olive drab, khaki canvas and brown leather.
TOP LEFT — Sergeant Schonmalweiter; maennlich-read; broad low squarish ink blob; weathered M1-style bowl helmet with short loose chinstrap, rolled sleeve tabs only, whistle and small folded map; clenched crooked mouth with one upper tooth; impatient sideglance and raised instructing goo hand. Personality: Turns every missing direction into a loudly announced shortcut.
TOP MIDDLE — Private Päckchen; maennlich-read; tall thin wobbly comma blob; oversized olive bowl helmet, two simple chest pouches, compact wood-stock rifle safely vertical muzzle upward at side; huge ivory eyes looking up under brim, tiny anxious toothless mouth. Personality: Carries everything required except a convincing explanation of where he is.
TOP RIGHT — Corporal Knister; weiblich-read; round pear-shaped blob with sharply uneven brows and very dry side-smirk; olive sidecap, two subtly long lashes, large simple handset attached by short coiled cord to small radio pack at flank; no full human jacket. Personality: Can hear a bad order clearly through any amount of static.
BOTTOM LEFT — Lieutenant Himmelwärts; maennlich-read; top-heavy bulbous blob, brown leather flight cap with goggles parked above uncovered eyes and short cream collar; a single broad aviation chart; stunned open oval mouth and one upper tooth, one eye stretched taller than other. Personality: Believes altitude will eventually improve the paperwork.
BOTTOM MIDDLE — Medic Ruhigblut; weiblich-read; wide asymmetric droplet blob; small plain olive helmet, compact medical pouch marked by simple ivory plus, rolled bandage in goo hand; lashes, fierce reassuring crooked grin with two uneven upper teeth; no syringe clutter. Personality: Insists that everyone panic one at a time.
BOTTOM RIGHT — Mechanic Drehmoment; maennlich-read; squat triangular rounded splat; soft olive work cap and short stained canvas bib patch leaving body visible, one thick spanner and dented metal oil can; bored heavy eyelids, compressed toothless zigzag lips. Personality: Repairs vehicles faster than officers can rename the fault.
COMPOSITION: Three columns,two rows. Equal substantial body scale, complete uncropped silhouettes and props each within about460x440px cell. Uniform visible heights across rows.32px clear transparent row/column gutters and generous outer margin. Do not overlap characters. All six self-contained,no floor,ground disc,backdrop,scenery,text,labels,border or gridlines. True transparent alpha.
